title: Animal
description: One fiber animal on the ranch. Draft for comment. Not final.

id.description: A short id the rancher picks, such as bramble. Lower-case letters, numbers, and dashes.

breed.description: Breed as the rancher writes it, such as Angora or Pygora.

name.description: The animal's barn name. Not a person's name.

tag.description: Ear tag or herd number as painted or printed on the tag. Not an electronic or collar ID.

color.description: Coat color, such as white or silver.

sharing.description: What the rancher chooses to share from this record. Nothing is shared unless the rancher picks it.

audience.description: Who may see this record. private means only the rancher. buyers means people who buy fiber from this ranch. public means anyone.

fields.description: The fields in this record that the audience may see. Fields not listed stay private. The id is always shared so records can link.
